review.decision: Add bounded native opportunity for prospective exact managed-task reports; keep affirmative claim and independent alerts separate from submission.
review.notes: Reviewed real incident refs 6dab55c89b86095c1b511cbeb0a67fbc and events:109573. Both are unassigned in workspace; classification must not require matter ID or inspect untrusted report prose. Keep all production state untouched. Fixtures use isolated storage, synthetic timing and native I/O. Device acceptance and transition from v188 remain separate.

cases.description: One protected relay slot coalesces with a full decision batch
cases.setup: Isolated queue with 200 p0 entries, controlled time and fake native receiver.
cases.action: Admit two candidates, then drain and observe the same batch and every original decision reference. Exercise old-reader suffix visibility.
cases.expected: One pending slot; second producer remains eligible. No decision evicted or trimmed. One original exact report ID and a full existing decision batch submit together. The old .txt queue reader ignores the protected slot.

cases.description: Unsafe input and unknown protected submissions are not replayed
cases.setup: Fake drafted, busy, copy-mode, unreadable and unverifiable panes; stable original target and durable native journal.
cases.action: Run drain for unsafe views, then simulate unknown result and revisit the same report across scheduler passes; additionally check safe refusal timing.
cases.expected: Zero terminal input while unsafe. Unknown retains original evidence and cannot trigger a second scheduler publication of that report. Only proven refusals can use bounded retry at the exact target.

cases.description: Scoped report and Stop evidence select a durable prospective opportunity
cases.setup: Synthetic relay and workspace with an old report, ordinary/unmanaged controls, different-home Stop, and an unassigned managed report with exact source Stop.
cases.action: Ingest, select, admit through the real scheduler, then add independent state changes before drain.
cases.expected: No old backlog is enrolled. Exact paired report wins, retains original source and claim state, and is dropped before submission after a genuine claim or closure. No report body is put in the wake.

cases.description: Independent report alert names the actual reference and stops after verified claim
cases.setup: Unclaimed enrolled report, no delivery evidence, fake clock, independent notification path with stale other-scope notice.
cases.action: Pass the lateness threshold and rescan; then claim or close the source and rescan.
cases.expected: One exact reference alert, independent of the queue or HQ presence. Limits apply to the reference, distinguish scheduling from acceptance, and clear on verified source or workspace claim.
